body:
@matsko do you agree that this is broken? I was still thinking that there might be a chance that I'm using AnimationOptions in a wrong way.

If it _is_ broken, then I might take the time to find a fix for this.

@konstantintieber I do not believe this is a bug. Looks like you are not using it correctly. Look at the docs: https://angular.io/guide/animations#transitions-and-timing
Specifically: 

> The transition() function accepts two arguments: the first argument accepts an expression that defines the direction between two transition states, and the second argument accepts an animate() function.

You sent it 3 parameters. The delay is sent inside the `animate` method. Here's your example with the correct syntax: https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-qq6tyv-zkxv39

@YonatanKra thanks for your feedback. However if you look at the API page of the [transition()](https://angular.io/api/animations/transition) function you see the third argument for AnimationOptions, which includes a delay property.

The difference between these two delays is, that the delay you define within the _animate()_ `timings` parameter will not delay the animation start event, unlike the `delay` from the `AnimationOptions` given in a _transition()_ call. See the first paragraph of my issue description.

When I debug this, I see this line:
`https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/f8096d499324cf0961f092944bbaedd05364eea1/packages/animations/browser/src/dsl/animation_transition_factory.ts#L45`
I don't know if it's the source of the issue but it seems the `delay` property from the options you set does not pass beyond this point.
@konstantintieber  I also need this type of thing.  @matsko please tell me progress of this issue?
This still appears to be an issue, is it being worked on?

I would appreciate if someone took a look at this... It's been almost a year, and I just stumbled upon it.

Seems like a straightforward feature.
Still present in v11.2.7. Since it is not fixed, it should be at least written in the documentation to avoid losing time searching for clues, please.
